notes: New plugins target Plugin API 1.14.0; Plugin API 1.10/1.11/1.12/1.13 packages remain loadable.
Plugin API 1.14 adds a Core-owned per-workbench import action and scoped Import Workbench mode. Workbench plugins declare data.accepts; they do not create their own import-data button or file picker.
A workbench may place an empty data-dkds-slot="workbench-import" marker to choose the standard import action location; Core falls back to the standard page-header action area.
Plugin API 1.13 scoped sources, assignments, standalone workbench placement and default icons remain the data/workbench foundation.
Plugin API 1.12 Interaction Behavior profiles remain the single mouse/keyboard/context/box/wheel policy layer.
ScientificCurveSurface accepts either an SVG or a normal container; Core owns the internal SVG and direct-manipulation lifecycle.
The SDK is standalone and does not require DK Data Studio source code.
Domain logic belongs to plugins; application infrastructure is consumed through ctx.* Core APIs.
